message: Mirrored in Z about Z-2.5 for the counter spindle: 10 words and 3 codes on 9 blocks (G2 and G3, G41 and G42 swapped). Machine 'Lathe B': it does not say how it reads numbers, so a word whose reading depends on that would refuse the run.
